annotations.title: Draft a listing for a person to submit

description: Draft a listing on MakerRadar for the person you're helping: give their product's website and, optionally, a name, tagline and description. Returns reviewUrl, a link the person opens to sign in, check the listing and submit it; nothing is published until they do (and MakerRadar reviews it). If the site is already listed, returns its page instead. No sign-in needed.

description.description: What it does and who it's for, 40–4000 characters of plain Markdown. Optional.

tagline.description: One line on what it does, 4–90 characters. Optional.

name: draft_listing

reviewUrl.description: The person opens it, signs in and submits the listing.

status.description: drafted: hand the person reviewUrl. listed: the site is listed at productUrl. on_file: we have it on file, not public.
